channel.title: Ocean science results (demo)
channel.description: Demo feed made for a G2 Digest video. Every item is invented; none of it is news.

item.title: Reef playback field trial: coral regrows 4x faster
item.description: A season-long trial played the sound of a healthy reef over damaged plots at night; settlement of young coral was four times that of silent plots.

item.title: Seawater battery holds charge 3x longer with a new salt membrane
item.description: A preprint reports a sea-salt electrolyte cell that loses a third as much charge while idle, thanks to a thin membrane that keeps salt off the electrodes.

item.title: Startup says the ocean will power everything
item.description: A press release with big claims and no numbers, data or trial.
